headline: Approved wallet symbols and safeguards against unexpected sprite changes

changes.title: Distinct owner-approved currency symbols in every wallet
changes.detail: Golden Nuts now display the existing golden acorn illustration, and Gems use the exact 01_r1c1_diamond slice from the Nut Buster Drive. The header, in-level balances, and gem-priced gravity-hold purchases share those identities, with gameplay currency values unchanged.

changes.title: Guard previously exported art against packaging regressions
changes.detail: Every supplementary atlas sprite is checked against its committed SHA-256 manifest, and normal Android and desktop packaging paths are tested to ensure they do not silently rerun the atlas slicers. No artwork was re-exported.
